spanish: Hoy ustedes salientes en el mes de las espigas.
grammarChanges: Translated h02013004005 (הָאָבִיב, definite article + Ncmsa, a common noun 'fresh/green ears of grain') as "las espigas" instead of leaving it untranslated as the proper name "Aviv", per the auditor fail.

Added the definite article "el" before "mes" (en mes de → en el mes de), since the construct phrase is overall definite once the nomen rectum is the common noun "las espigas" rather than a bare proper name.
